diff --git b/deb/quadlet/pi-hole.container a/deb/quadlet/pi-hole.container
index c28fa02..80e8333 100644
--- b/deb/quadlet/pi-hole.container
+++ a/deb/quadlet/pi-hole.container
@@ -45,23 +45,11 @@ HealthRetries=5
 # 90s gives pihole-FTL plenty of time to initialize. Gravity is pre-built
 # in the image so no first-start gravity download is required.
 HealthStartPeriod=90s
-# Health reports; it never restarts (see tor-haproxy.container: the
-# nice-dns-health controller is the one restart owner, DEC-021,
-# WF-DNS-002). A second owner here would race the controller's restart
-# ladder (lib/policy.sh). A process that exits is still restarted by
-# Restart= below.
-HealthOnFailure=none
+HealthOnFailure=restart
 
 [Service]
 Restart=on-failure
-# Back off when the container keeps exiting (systemd 254: RestartSteps=,
-# RestartMaxDelaySec=; they need a non-zero RestartSec=). On 2026-11-02 VM
-# memory exhaustion aborted haproxy (rc 134) and its unit restarted every
-# 3 s for 20 hours, about 1100 times an hour: StartLimitBurst never trips
-# at that cadence. Now the delay grows from 3 s to 5 min in 5 steps.
 RestartSec=3s
-RestartSteps=5
-RestartMaxDelaySec=300s
 TimeoutStopSec=70
 
 [Install]
